'''Dra'jhok''' was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] within the religious pantheon of the [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was called the Sender of Battle, and he had a brother named [[Dra'vil]].<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
